lines.text: You're crushing it at your new job!

data.define: Used when someone is doing really well at something.

example.text: You're crushing it at your new job!

misuse.text: Don't tell a struggling friend 'crushing it' sarcastically.

data.l1_hook: Primeira semana e já é o mais vendido! Você está "crushing it".
data.l1_ex: Você está arrasando ("crushing it") no seu emprego novo!

native.tip: “crushing it” = arrasando. Exemplo: “You're crushing it at your new job!”
